Patternly Partner Studio

Publish your kit patterns to the Patternly Stitch Tracker — your customers stitch on screen, your chart file never leaves the server.

Patternly for Brands · by Luca-S
Put your cross-stitch kits inside the app your customers stitch with

Patternly's Stitch Tracker lets stitchers follow their chart on screen — tap off every stitch, never lose their place, progress synced across devices. Partner brands publish their own kits into it, protected, in minutes.

Why brands join
Your charts stay protected

Customers stitch on screen — the chart is streamed into the app, never handed out as a PDF that can be copied, shared or resold.

Your own Partner Studio

Convert your chart in the browser, publish it under your brand with your shop's buy button, and print QR insert cards for the kit box — all self-serve.

Your customers, your support

See who is stitching your kits and how far along they are, look a customer up by email when they write to you, and help them yourself.

Earn catalogue placement

Your kits open by QR from day one — and active partners can be listed in the shared catalogue stitchers browse, cover photo and “Buy the kit” button included. Free exposure to people who already buy kits, earned as your kits see real use.

Free for your brand

No fees, no servers, no app to build. Your customers unlock the tracker with Patternly Plus — 14-day free trial — exactly like Luca-S customers do.

How it works
From chart file to a kit your customers can stitch in the app — three steps.
Convert

Drop your chart file into the built-in converter. It becomes a protected .Ptly file right in your browser — nothing is uploaded during conversion.

Publish

Upload the .Ptly with a title, cover photo and your shop link. It's live in the app under your brand the same minute — or staged hidden until the kits ship.

Print & ship

Every pattern gets a QR code, an access code and a print-ready insert card with your logo. Slip it in the kit box — your customer scans it and stitches along.

Overview

Convert your chart Open full screen

The Patternly Converter turns your chart file into the .Ptly format the Stitch Tracker serves — the same tool Luca-S kits are prepared with. It currently reads .xsp charts; if your patterns live in another format, send Luca-S a sample file and support for it will be added. Check the preview and edit the colour table — thread numbers, symbols and metres per colour — then export the .Ptly file. The preview is what your customers will stitch from: what you approve here is exactly what we serve. Then publish it from the My Patterns tab.
Publish straight to the catalogue
Skips the download step: the .ptly you just converted - and the legend PDF, if you loaded one - is saved under this SKU, same as uploading it on the Patterns tab. Luca-S / house-brand SKUs only (no dash). If the SKU already has a pattern file you'll be asked before it's replaced.

My Patterns

Each pattern has its own access code and QR link — print them on your kit inserts; your customers scan the QR (or type the code) and the kit opens in the Stitch Tracker. Patterns aren’t shown in the public catalogue by default — active partners can be granted catalogue placement by Luca-S.

All patterns — partner brands + the Luca-S catalogue

Adds or updates a Luca-S pattern — only the SKU is required. Save just the SKU to reserve it (access code, QR and insert card work immediately); add or replace the .Ptly, legend, cover or title any time by saving the same SKU again — only what you attach changes. With a title the kit is live in the Stitch Tracker as soon as it has a pattern file; when the Shopify product links later, its title, photo and buy button take over automatically.

Automatic notifications

Sent by the app on its own, in the person’s language, with their project name and progress. Events fire instantly; the reminder scan runs hourly in the background. Nobody gets more than one automatic message per cap period, and nothing is sent during quiet hours (it waits until morning, their time).
